name: Supplier Due Diligence
description: Evaluate a prospective supplier across capability, ownership, financial/operational resilience, quality, security, compliance evidence, concentration, and exit risk.

tasks.name: Define supplier requirements
tasks.objective: Set critical products/services, volumes, quality tolerances, lead times, locations, continuity expectations, data/security exposure, compliance obligations, budget, and unacceptable dependencies.

tasks.name: Build supplier profile
tasks.objective: Collect ownership, locations, management, key customers/suppliers, production/service capacity, financial indicators, insurance, certifications and scope, litigation/regulatory history where relevant, and subcontracting.

tasks.name: Verify operational capability
tasks.objective: Review process controls, quality system, capacity evidence, staffing, equipment, testing, traceability, defect handling, delivery history, support, change control, and representative references or audits.

tasks.name: Assess resilience and risk
tasks.objective: Analyze single points of failure, geography, utilities/logistics, cyber/data exposure, financial stress, key-person dependence, upstream concentration, sanctions/export considerations where relevant, disaster recovery, and insurance.

tasks.name: Review commercial and exit terms
tasks.objective: Normalize pricing and assumptions; examine minimums, indexation, payment, warranties, service levels, remedies, IP/data terms, audit rights, termination, transition support, tooling/data return, and switching costs.

tasks.name: Publish diligence record
tasks.objective: Summarize verified evidence, gaps, conditions, mitigations, contract protections to seek, monitoring metrics, contingency/dual-source options, and unresolved risks without collapsing everything into a decorative score.
